scale_estimates.model: Prime number theorem: pi(x) ~ x/ln(x), x=sqrt(R).
scale_estimates.classification: Asymptotic scale estimates, not measurements or rigorous lower bounds.
scale_estimates.approximation: log10(P) approximated by E*log10(2), log10(R) by E*log10(2)+log10(3); the +/-1 terms are neglected.

hypothetical_full_scan.classification: Optimistic toy scenario for enumerating every member of the full basis; not a benchmark and not a limit for other algorithms.
hypothetical_full_scan.cost_model: One check per basis prime; generating, storing and accessing the basis are assigned zero cost.
hypothetical_full_scan.formula: log10(years) = log10(estimated basis count) - 12 - log10(seconds per year)

interpretation: Visible logical CPUs, the affinity set and the cgroup CPU quota are different quantities.
The cgroup memory limit is the relevant local limit; host physical RAM is not substituted for it.
memory.swap.max='max' means no limit in the observed cgroup file, not that swap is available; actual swap observations are reported separately.
Absence of exposed GPU device paths says nothing about GPUs elsewhere on the host or remote resources.
The packed P payload omits Python object overhead and arithmetic work buffers.
The scale estimate concerns the current complete-root-basis approach, not every possible exact shadow method or primality algorithm.
The bounded record experiment leaves 3P-82 unresolved; no new prime is established.
